subject: Atlas POC: cost and model-mix confirmation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@atlashealth.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya@atlashealth.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Atlas POC: cost and model-mix confirmation

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the walkthrough of the Atlas use case and the sample data. Per our conversation, I wanted to capture the numbers we discussed and the immediate asks so we can lock the POC scope. High level: cost sensitivity is the gating item. Please confirm the volume/budget numbers below or correct as needed.

Recap / ask (short):
- Monthly active users: ~75k (we heard this in your notes)
- Expected calls per MAU: 2.8 (mix of search, chat, and autosuggest)
- Target monthly token volume (ballpark): 40M–60M tokens/month
- Budget range (procurement): $35k–$65k/month (you indicated a stretch to $75k if value is proven)
- Redwood target unit economics you asked for: goal is to get to ~$1,000 per 1M tokens (we discussed aiming for $900–$1,200 as a workable band)

Model mix (your preference; please confirm):
- Chat (interactive assistants / session generation): 70–75% of tokens
- Embeddings (semantic search / similarity): 20–25%
- Rerank (short re-ranking calls): 3–5%

Immediate next steps I recommend:
1) You confirm average prompt/generation lengths for the chat flows (avg prompt ~300 tokens? avg completion ~900 tokens?) — these drive per-session token math.
2) We’ll produce a 2-option cost sheet (conservative / optimized) that shows per-model $/1M token and monthly total given the two volume scenarios (40M and 60M). Attached draft will include implementation levers (batching, prefix caching, lighter model fallback).
3) Schedule a 30-minute technical kickoff with Monica from our infra team to validate latency and KV cache requirements.

If that all looks right I’ll send the estimate + MOP (mutual action plan) by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: atlas_cost_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet; draft numbers)

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@atlashealth.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@atlashealth.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Atlas POC: cost and model-mix confirmation

Thanks Karthik — this is helpful. A few clarifying Qs before you finalize the numbers: 

1) Can you break the per-model $/1M token into prompt vs completion where relevant? Our chat prompts are often long (user context + history).
2) For embeddings: we expect a steady stream of short calls (avg 128 tokens input). Do you price embeddings differently per vector size or is this flat?
3) Latency requirement: for the clinical triage flow we need 95th pctile < 400ms for short responses; is that achievable with the recommended config?
4) If we do a hybrid model mix (chat-heavy during office hours, embeddings-heavy off-hours), can Redwood route by policy and give us blended monthly spend?

Also — happy to share a redacted sample of typical chat prompts if that makes the sizing more accurate. When you say "optimized" approach what typical discounts / levers are you assuming?

— Sanjay
Head of Product, Atlas Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@atlashealth.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya@atlashealth.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 07:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Atlas POC: cost and model-mix confirmation

Sanjay — great questions. See answers and the attached quick estimate (atlas_cost_estimate.xlsx). I put two scenarios (Base / Optimized) for both 40M and 60M token bands. Key points below.

Per-model unit breakdown (examples; per 1M tokens):
- Chat (large conversational model; we show prompt/completion split):
  - Prompt portion: $420 / 1M tokens
  - Completion portion: $780 / 1M tokens
  - Blended chat: $1,200 / 1M tokens (base); Optimized: ~$900 / 1M tokens with batching + quantized variant + prefix cache
- Embeddings (128-token inputs typical):
  - Flat: $220 / 1M tokens (embeddings are cheaper and scale well)
  - Optimized: $180 / 1M tokens with batching and smaller vector quantization
- Rerank (short, high-qps calls): $650 / 1M tokens (base); optimized $480 / 1M tokens

Notes on latency and routing:
- 95th pctile <400ms is achievable for short completions if we pin chat inference to our low-latency pool (Dedicated small instance) and enable KV prefix caching. That will push you toward a reserved capacity commit for those endpoints (we can model that into the POC pricing).
- Hybrid routing (office-hours heavier chat; off-hours embeddings) is supported. We provide blended monthly spend in dashboard and can create routing rules in the MOP so billing maps to the traffic split.

Sample monthly math (rounded):
- Conservative (40M tokens) with 75/20/5 split at base rates -> ~$44k/month
- Optimized (40M tokens) with same split and optimizations -> ~$33k/month
- Conservative (60M tokens) -> ~$66k/month
- Optimized (60M tokens) -> ~$49k/month

Takeaways: if your procurement target is ~$1,000 / 1M tokens we can be inside the band on the Optimized scenario for 40–60M, assuming you enable the optimizations and a short reserved commit for the latency-critical chat endpoints. The attached sheet shows the per-model traffic slices and the sensitivity to prompt/completion lengths.

Next steps (proposed):
- You share 3–5 redacted sessions (chat transcripts) so we can refine average prompt/completion tokens.
- Monica will run a short infra kick (30m) to validate 95th-pctile latency on a 2-week staging run.
- We’ll draft a 2-week POC statement of work + MSA addendum (Lauren will draft legal/finance items).

I’ve attached atlas_cost_estimate.xlsx (draft). If you want I can convert the two scenarios into a single slide for procurement.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
